usedFor: Process Street holds checklists and runs, and Google Business Profile receives a public reply through “Reply To Review”.

bestTemplate.name: “Workflow Run Completed” in Process Street, then “Reply To Review” in Google Business Profile
bestTemplate.why: A completed run can be the sign-off step before a reply to a review posts.

watchOut: “Reply To Review” in Google Business Profile posts a public response, and anything reaching outsiders waits for approval.
